to Lease Agreement
by and between
(1) Mr. Mohammad Nadeem Mansha Sb Mohammad Mansha, holding CNIC No.
35201-1533636-5 ("Lessor 1"), (2) Atif Bashir S/a Muhammad Bashir Chaudhary,
holding CNIC No. 35201-1527911-9 ("Lessor 2") (Collectively referred to as the
"Lessors") and Zameen Media (Private) Limited ("Lessee")
[Each a Party" and, collectively, "Par-ties"]
This first amendment (First Amendment") to the Lease Agreement dated 20th August, 2021
('Lease Agreement") is made and entered into at Lahore on this 15th February, 2023.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Lease Agreement wherein the Lessors granted on lease. and
the Lessee took on lease from the Lessors, shop No. SF-04 measuring 1169 sq.ft situated
at second floor of a commercial building namely 'Square One' located at property No.
SXX-A-110-B/3/lll, Gulberg Ill, Lahore ('Demised Premises"): and

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Lease Agreement as per the
terms and conditions of this First Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
The First Amendment shall be effective from 16th May, 2023 ("Effective Date").
The Parties acknowledge that the designated bank account for payment of Monthly Rent
under clause 3.2 of the Agreement is hereby revised by the Lessors. From the Effective
Date, Monthly Rent shall be paid by the Lessee to the Lessors in the following manner:
Fifty percent (50%) of the Monthly Rent to Lessor 1 through bank deposit in the bank
account of Lessor 1 detailed below:

From the Effective Date, the Lessee shall only be liable to deposit the Monthly Rent in the
bank accounts specified in this Clause 2 and shall not be responsible for any claims in
relation thereto.
All other terms and provisions in the Lease Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and
shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the
event of any conflict, the terms of this First Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting
term in the Lease Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.
This First Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Lease Agreement.
All expressions and terms defined or used in the Lease Agreement shall bear the same
meaning in this First Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.
6.

This First Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall
constitute one and the same amendment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Amendment, having fully
understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
